Gaussian input

Link 0 commands

The Link 0 commands set the job’s memory, processors and files before the route; each is explained after the Gaussian manual.

Command Value Meaning
%OldChk Checkpoint file copied into this job’s checkpoint at the start, to read data from a previous calculation.
%Mem 8 GB Dynamic memory available to Gaussian.
%NProcShared 8 Number of processors used in shared-memory parallel execution.
%Chk Checkpoint file this job writes.

Route keywords and options

The route selects the method, basis set and job type. Each keyword is listed with its meaning, followed by its options, as Gaussian read them.

Keyword

Meaning

Options

Option

Value

Meaning

IOp

Internal options overriding program defaults.

3/76

5.389 \mathord{\times}10^{8}

Sets the density-functional exchange weight P_1=0.5389 and the Hartree–Fock exchange weight P_2=0.4611 in E_{\mathrm{xc}}=P_2E_x^{\mathrm{HF}}+P_1(P_4E_x^{\mathrm{Slater}}+P_3\Delta E_x^{\mathrm{nonlocal}})+P_6E_c^{\mathrm{local}}+P_5\Delta E_c^{\mathrm{nonlocal}}.

3/78

7.3411 \mathord{\times}10^{8}

Sets the nonlocal correlation-correction weight P_5=0.7341 and the local correlation weight P_6=0.7341.

BLYP

BLYP density functional: Becke 88 exchange with LYP correlation; the IOps below may reweight it.

6-31G(d,p)

Pople split-valence double-zeta basis with d polarization functions on heavy atoms and p functions on hydrogen; also written 6-31G**.

NoSymm

Keep the input orientation and do not use molecular symmetry.

Int

Computation of the two-electron integrals and the DFT integration grid.

UltraFine

Pruned (99,590) integration grid: 99 radial shells with 590 angular points each.

SCF

Controls of the self-consistent field procedure.

Tight

Tight SCF convergence, the default.

XQC

Add a quadratically convergent SCF step if the first-order SCF has not converged.

MaxCycle

512

At most 512 SCF cycles.

Geom

Source and handling of the molecule specification.

AllCheck

Take the geometry, charge, multiplicity and title from the checkpoint file.

Guess

Initial guess for the SCF wavefunction.

Read

Read the initial guess from the checkpoint file.

Freq

Harmonic force constants, vibrational frequencies, intensities and thermochemistry.

Vibrational frequencies

The harmonic analysis gave 30 modes, 0 of them imaginary. The stick spectrum places each mode’s infrared intensity at its wavenumber, imaginary modes at negative wavenumbers.

The viewer animates every imaginary mode, the six lowest real modes and the four most intense in the infrared, each with a largest atomic excursion of 0.6 \mathrm{\AA}; choose one in its snapshot selector. Faded copies spread over the mode’s frames trail the motion; the trail button on the right toolbar hides them.
